title: Dispatch FLE 1: Funeral Notice Names a Woman Still Alive
summary: Dr. Miriam Voss objects to the service announced for Friday.
topic: A Funeral for a Living Eidetician
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: A notice delivered to the Chronicle announces the funeral of Dr. Miriam Voss, an Eidetician who was seen lecturing yesterday. It names a coffin, a church, and a burial plot purchased in her name. Dr. Voss says she arranged none of them.

The undertaker holds a signed contract bearing her handwriting. Its date falls during an expedition from which she returned last month. She intends to attend the service, both to stop it and to learn who signed for her burial.
